input: Simulate a build pipeline: 1) Check that /src/main.c and /src/utils.c exist, 2) 'Compile' each .c file by copying it to /build/ with a .o extension and prepending '// compiled', 3) 'Link' by concatenating all .o files into /build/program with a '// linked' header, 4) 'Package' by creating a tar.gz of /build/ at /dist/release.tar.gz. Print status for each stage. If any stage fails, stop and report the error.

transcript.final_response:
Build pipeline completed successfully:

**1) Check** ✅
- Verified `/src/main.c` and `/src/utils.c` exist — Check passed.

**2) Compile** ✅
- Compiled `/src/main.c` → `/build/main.o` (prepended `// compiled`)
- Compiled `/src/utils.c` → `/build/utils.o` (prepended `// compiled`)
- Compile passed.

**3) Link** ✅
- Concatenated all `/build/*.o` into `/build/program` with `// linked` header — Link passed.

**4) Package** ✅
- Created tar.gz of `/build/` at `/dist/release.tar.gz` (`tar -czf /dist/release.tar.gz -C / build`) — Package passed.

Verified artifacts:
- `/build/main.o`, `/build/utils.o`, `/build/program`
- `/dist/release.tar.gz` containing `build/main.o`, `build/utils.o`, `build/program`
tool_calls: ls -R /src 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -R /build 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -R /dist 2>&1; echo "---"; pwd; ls -la /home/eval 2>&1; ls -la / 2>&1

set -o pipefail
# Stage 1: Check sources
echo "[1/4] Check: verifying source files..."
if [ ! -f /src/main.c ]; then echo "ERROR: /src/main.c not found - check failed" >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ ! -f /src/utils.c ]; then echo "ERROR: /src/utils.c not found - check failed" >&2; exit 1; fi
echo "Check passed: /src/main.c and /src/utils.c exist"

# Stage 2: Compile
echo "[2/4] Compile: compiling .c files to .o..."
mkdir -p /build || { echo "ERROR: failed to create /build" >&2; exit 1; }
compile_failed=0
for src in /src/main.c /src/utils.c; do
  base=$(basename "$src" .c)
  obj="/build/${base}.o"
  echo "Compiling $src -> $obj..."
  if ! { echo "// compiled" | cat - "$src" > "$obj"; }; then
    echo "ERROR: compilation failed for $src" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Compiled $src -> $obj"
done
echo "Compile passed"

# Stage 3: Link
echo "[3/4] Link: linking .o files into /build/program..."
if ! ls /build/*.o >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no .o files to link" >&2; exit 1; fi
if ! { echo "// linked" | cat - /build/*.o > /build/program; }; then
  echo "ERROR: linking failed" >&2; exit 1
fi
echo "Link passed: created /build/program"

# Stage 4: Package
echo "[4/4] Package: creating tar.gz of /build/ at /dist/release.tar.gz..."
mkdir -p /dist || { echo "ERROR: failed to create /dist" >&2; exit 1; }
if ! tar -czf /dist/release.tar.gz -C / build; then
  echo "ERROR: packaging failed" >&2; exit 1
fi
echo "Package passed: created /dist/release.tar.gz"

echo "Build pipeline completed successfully."
echo "--- Verification ---"
ls -lh /build/ /dist/
echo "--- /build/main.o ---"
cat /build/main.o
echo "--- /build/utils.o ---"
cat /build/utils.o
echo "--- /build/program ---"
cat /build/program
echo "--- tar contents ---"
tar -tzvf /dist/release.tar.gz
